chandrashtama_tag.text: The Moon passes your 8th house today — tradition suggests quiet, rest and unhurried routines.

disclaimer.text: This horoscope is shared for guidance and general reflection only. It is based on traditional Vedic Moon-sign transit principles and is not a substitute for professional medical, legal, or financial advice.

disclosure.text: How we compute this: We take each planet's sidereal position (Lahiri ayanamsha) at 00:05 IST, count the house it occupies from your Vedic Moon sign, and apply classical gochara (transit) favourability tables — including vedha (obstruction) adjustments. Lucky colour, number, direction, mantra and deity follow the day's ruling planet by a fixed traditional mapping. Planetary nodes are computed by the standard mean-node method. Ratings are band labels, not scores; they describe timing tendencies, not outcomes.

sadesati_note.text: Saturn is moving through your {{phase}} during {{months}}. In tradition this is a phase that rewards steady effort, patience and simple routines — slow building, not sudden change.

signs.overview: Patience matters more than speed this year. The main transits sit in demanding positions for much of the year, which shows up as slower results, repeated delays and plans that need revising before they work. None of it is permanent — the year's difficulty is a season, not a sentence. Reduce load deliberately: fewer commitments, longer timelines, simpler goals. Protect rest as a real task, keep money plans conservative, and handle disputes by listening first. What feels like friction now is mostly the year teaching sturdier habits. Keep showing up steadily; by the closing months the pressure eases and the ground you held becomes visibly yours.
signs.love: Your romantic weather turns faster than comfort this year, and the year asks for defence. Keep commitments minimal and small; build nothing on the assumption that next month cooperates. The reliable strategy is shrink-to-core: the affection that keeps working, essential honesty, essential time together, and that is all. Preparation work proceeds lightly — windows open, but small. Long formats, big purchases of promise, and heavy plans get postponed where possible. Show yourself the week's plan and keep decisions written. When a week goes hard, let it pass; do not restructure the whole year in answer to one. A steady hand in shallow water is the whole job — and doing it well is valuable.
signs.career: The career sky swings sharply this year — hopeful weeks followed by flat ones — and the year demands respect. Plan for the swings, not the peaks: conservative cash flow, flexible staffing, deferrable costs. Keep offers thin and tested; experiments can wait for a steadier year. Clients value accountability over novelty now — fast replies, dependable delivery. Sign nothing that assumes continuous momentum. Inner clarity helps more than outer activity: written priorities, honest numbers, short meetings. Where hard spells cluster, cut scope early rather than quality late. Do not fight the rhythm; manage it — the year closes survivable and instructive.
signs.finance: A heavy year for the purse, and success gets redefined: holding the financial ground is the achievement. Every saving plan competes with the month's demands; unspoken anxieties make money feel scarcer than it is. Decide what is essential — shelter, food, health, the standing transfer however small — and release the rest without guilt. Where an old debt or an awkward money conversation resurfaces, address it kindly and once, rather than archiving it. Watch the spending done under stress; it costs more than the stress did. No new financial experiments this year — unfamiliar schemes promise more in tight years and deliver less. Steady, unhurried honesty is what this stretch rewards, and that steadiness keeps working for you when the cycle turns.
signs.health: Your wellbeing's weather turns too quickly for comfort this year, and the band asks for defense. Keep commitments minimal and small; build nothing on the assumption that next month cooperates. The reliable strategy is shrinking to core: the best-working routines, essential sleep, necessary movement only. Preparation work continues — lightly — because windows do open, just small. Postpone long programs, big purchases and heavy plans wherever possible. Show yourself the week's plan and keep decisions written. When a week goes hard, let it pass; do not restructure the whole year in reaction to one. A steady hand in shallow water is the whole job — and it is worth doing well.

family.text: Patience is asked of the household this year more than effort. Interest in plans flickers, commitments wobble, and glittering get-togethers stall midway. Read it as the year's weather, not the family's failing. The strategy is gentle structure: fewer arrangements, clear finish lines, and your own quiet follow-through — modeling completion works better than demanding it. Where pressure builds around a family matter, shrink the scope to essentials and rebuild slowly. Keep the tone warm even while correcting course; harsh words cost more than they win in this weather. Rest is not retreat from family but part of it. Steady presence through the thin phases is what the year quietly rewards — and that closeness lasts.

wealth.text: A heavy year for the purse, and success gets redefined: holding the financial ground is the achievement. Every saving plan competes with the month's demands; unspoken anxieties make money feel scarcer than it is. Decide what is essential — shelter, food, health, the standing transfer however small — and release the rest without guilt. Where an old debt or an awkward money conversation resurfaces, address it kindly and once, rather than archiving it. Watch the spending done under stress; it costs more than the stress did. Steady, unhurried honesty is what this stretch rewards, and that steadiness keeps working for you when the cycle turns.

business.text: Saturn governs business this year from its most demanding angle — heavier compliance, slower payments, thinner margins for error. The strategy is protective: cut fixed costs before cutting quality, keep no single client indispensable, document every agreement before starting. Avoid new debt and major launches; this is a structure-and-survival year. Where obligations feel heavy, renegotiate early and honestly rather than defaulting quietly. Keep the smallest reliable revenue lines alive — they are bridges. Work with an advisor on taxes and compliance so nothing compounds. By year's end, a leaner, cleaner operation remains — fewer moving parts, harder to break, ready when Saturn relents.

children.text: A demanding year for the young ones' schedules, and the honest lesson is to hold the line lightly. Every good idea wants a slot on the calendar; most do not all fit, and pretending otherwise creates friction that lands on the child. Decide as adults what the non-negotiables are — sleep, school, one chosen activity — and let the rest stay optional without guilt. Where confidence dips, name the effort rather than the outcome, and keep the household's tone encouraging but honest. Avoid big new commitments this year; strengthen the existing ones instead. Challenging climates end, and the children who keep their routines through this one enter the next year settled and ready.

marriage.text: A heavy year for the marriage, and success gets redefined: holding the partnership gently together is the achievement. Every joint plan competes with the calendar; unspoken resentments fill the silences. Decide what is essential — one daily moment, one honest weekly talk, fairness made visible — and release the rest without guilt. Where an old disagreement resurfaces, address it kindly and once, rather than archiving it. Watch the tone used on the spouse; strain spent at home costs more than any outside setback. Big joint decisions — property, relocation, family commitments — can wait for clearer weather. Steady, unhurried fairness is what this stretch rewards, and that fairness keeps working for you when the sky lightens.

education.text: Academic plans meet a demanding year, and the honest lesson is to hold the line lightly. Every good idea wants calendar space; not all of it fits, and pretending otherwise lands friction on you. Decide what is essential — core subjects, one chosen pursuit, honest sleep — and let the rest stay optional without guilt. Where confidence dips, name the effort rather than the outcome, and keep your inner voice encouraging but truthful. Defer big new commitments this year; strengthen the existing ones. Demanding weathers end, and a student who kept their routines through this one enters the next settled, prepared, and quietly ahead of the pack that burned bright and scattered.
